name: Grade 10 Chemistry Term 1 Exam
subject: Chemistry
instructions: Answer ALL questions. Show all working.

items.question: The atomic number of an element is the number of?
Which of these is a noble gas?
The pH of an acid is?
The process of separating a solid from a liquid using filter paper is?

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (76 marks)
items: 1. Define the terms element, compound and mixture. (3 marks)
2. Write the electronic configuration of sodium (atomic number 11). (3 marks)
3. Balance the equation: H2 + O2 -> H2O (3 marks)
4. State two differences between metals and non-metals. (2 marks)
5. Using the periodic table section in the diagram, name the element in group 1 period 3. (3 marks)
6. What is the difference between a physical and a chemical change? Give an example of each. (4 marks)
7. Calculate the relative molecular mass of carbon dioxide (C = 12, O = 16). (3 marks)
